exactText: Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life; dream of it; think of it; live on that idea. Let the brain, the body, muscles, nerves, every part of your body be full of that idea, and just leave every other idea alone. This is the way to success, and this is the way great spiritual giants are produced.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: Never think there is anything impossible for the soul. It is the greatest heresy to think so. If there is sin, this is the only sin; to say that you are weak, or others are weak.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: All power is within you; you can do anything and everything. Believe in that, do not believe that you are weak; do not believe that you are half-crazy lunatics, as most of us do nowadays. Stand up and express the divinity within you.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
section: Lectures from Colombo to Almora: The Mission of the Vedanta
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: The greatest error is to believe that we are weak or that we are sinners. You are the pure and perfect souls. Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: When you are doing any work, do not think of anything beyond. Do it as worship, as the highest worship, and devote your whole life to it for the time being.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
section: Karma-Yoga: Each is Great in His Own Place
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: Every vicious thought will rebound, every thought of hatred which you may have thought in a cave even, is stored up, and will one day come back to you with tremendous power in the form of some misery here. If you project hatred and jealousy, they will rebound on you with compound interest.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: Unselfishness is more paying, only people have not the patience to practice it. It is more paying from the point of view of health also. Love, truth, and unselfishness are not merely moral figures of speech, but they form our highest ideal, because in them lies such a manifestation of power.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
section: Jnana-Yoga: The Real and the Apparent Man
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: Comfort is not the test of truth. Truth is often far from being comfortable. If you wish for truth, you must be prepared to go through that which is not comfortable.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda

exactText: In a day, when you don't come across any problems - you can be sure that you are travelling in a wrong path. Facing them with courage is what unveils the inner strength.
title: Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda
author: Swami Vivekananda
